description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5330015660993 PARTS KIT,SEAL REPL: Line 0001 Qty 194 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0077 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
